title: 特別篇 S01｜可被說出的表徵：語言模型裡的全域工作空間｜Anthropic 2026 論文導讀
description:
一個語言模型在回答時會產生龐大的內部表徵，但其中只有一小部分是它真的能說出口的。Anthropic 2026 年的論文《Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models》（Gurnee 等人）主張，這些可被說出的表徵在模型裡構成了一個類似「全域工作空間」的結構。

方法上，作者提出雅可比透鏡（Jacobian lens）：把最終輸出對某一層的活化取梯度，在一千個提示與各個位置上平均，得到一個線性映射 J；用 J 取代上面所有的層，就能把中間層的活化直接讀成詞彙分數。這些透鏡向量遠多於模型維度，是一組過完備基底；把任一活化分解成大約 25 個透鏡向量的稀疏非負組合，就得到它在工作空間裡的座標。關鍵是這個成分佔全部變異不到一成，卻承擔了不成比例的功能。

影片依序示範五個功能性質：
一、口語報告 —— 請模型心裡想一個運動，透鏡在中層就讀出 soccer；換成 rugby 的座標，模型說出口的就變成 rugby。只換工作空間成分成功率 59%，換掉其餘成分只有 5%。
二、指向性調控 —— 讓模型一邊抄寫無關句子、一邊心裡想著柑橘，透鏡讀出 orange 與 lemon；叫它不要想，出現率明顯下降卻不會歸零，很像人的白熊效應。
三、內部推理 —— 問「會結網的動物有幾條腿」，spider 從未寫出來卻清楚出現在中層讀數；把 spider 換成 ant，答案就從 8 變成 6。
四、彈性泛化 —— 同一個代表 France 的向量換成 China 之後，問首都、問語言、問所在的洲，三個不同下游運算全都跟著改。
五、選擇性 —— 把 Spanish 的向量換成 French，續寫與異常偵測不受影響，但說出語言、推論作家的答案就跟著換。

結構上，工作空間只在中間大約三分之一的層運作（約第 38 到 92 層），同時活躍的概念只有 10 到 25 個；壓制它之後淺層任務幾乎不受影響，多跳推理的正確率卻掉到接近零。工作空間方向也比其他方向更容易被下游權重接上（廣播樞紐），而歧義輸入會在工作空間起點附近突然收斂到單一解讀，很像神經科學的點火現象。作者強調，這些結果並沒有回答模型是否有主觀經驗；但在功能層次上，一組容量有限、可被報告、可被指揮、又能廣播的表徵確實存在於模型內部。

原文：https://transformer-circuits.pub/2026/workspace/index.html

本影片為教學動畫系列的特別篇（繁體中文版）。

title: Special S01 | Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
description:
When a language model answers, it builds an enormous number of internal representations, yet only a small part of them can ever be spoken. The 2026 Anthropic paper "Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models" (Gurnee et al.) argues that these verbalizable representations form something like a global workspace inside the model.

The method is the Jacobian lens: differentiate the final output with respect to one layer, average that over a thousand prompts and all positions to obtain a linear map J, then use J in place of every layer above, reading a middle-layer activation directly as vocabulary scores. The lens vectors far outnumber the model dimensions, so they form an overcomplete set; decomposing any activation into a sparse non-negative combination of about 25 of them gives its workspace coordinates. That component holds under ten percent of the total activation variance, yet carries far more than its share of the function.

The video walks through the five functional properties:
1. Verbal report — ask the model to think of a sport and the lens already reads soccer in the middle layers; swap those coordinates for rugby and it says rugby. Swapping the workspace component alone works on 59 percent of trials, the remainder on 5 percent.
2. Directed modulation — asked to copy an unrelated sentence while holding citrus in mind, the lens reads orange and lemon at the copying positions; told not to think of them, the rate drops sharply but never to zero, echoing the white-bear effect.
3. Internal reasoning — asked how many legs the animal that spins webs has, the word spider never appears in the question or the answer yet stands out in the middle-layer readout; swap spider for ant and the answer turns from 8 into 6.
4. Flexible generalization — swap the single vector standing for France to China and the capital, the language and the continent all follow, across three different downstream operations.
5. Selectivity — swap Spanish to French and continuation and anomaly detection are unaffected, while naming the language and inferring an author follow the swap.

Structurally the workspace operates only in the middle third of the layers (roughly 38 to 92 on a normalized depth scale) and holds only 10 to 25 concepts at once. Suppress it and shallow tasks are essentially unaffected while multi-hop reasoning drops to near zero. Workspace directions also compose with downstream weights far more broadly than other directions, a broadcast hub, and an ambiguous input commits sharply to one reading right where the workspace begins, much like neural ignition. The authors are explicit that none of this answers whether the model has subjective experience; but functionally, a limited-capacity set of representations that can be reported, directed and broadcast really does exist inside the model.

Paper: https://transformer-circuits.pub/2026/workspace/index.html

A special episode of the animated teaching series (English edition).
